title: Minimum Difficulty of a Job Schedule
goal: Schedule ordered jobs across exactly d nonempty days to minimize the sum of daily maximum difficulty.
strategy: Try every possible final-day starting job. Its cost is the maximum difficulty in that suffix block, added to the best valid schedule for earlier jobs on one fewer day.
